text: This report recommends five candidates for appointment to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board.

City Council on October 11 and 12, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council waive the two-term limit provision of the Public Appointments Policy and appoint Jaimie Grossman to the Larry Grossman Forest Hill Memorial Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending September 7, 2027, and until a successor is appointed.
